hook.name: hook
hook.reason: Alexander's cold, authoritative command 'Then let the Crown decide.' immediately sets up a high-stakes power confrontation.

narrative_tension.name: narrative_tension
narrative_tension.reason: Tension mounts steadily from the presentation of the dossier to the reading of the military report, the naming of the conspirators, and the final devastating accusation.

cliffhanger.name: cliffhanger
cliffhanger.reason: Ending on Alexander's venomous delivery of 'You took my title.' leaves the viewer eager to see the immediate fallout and retribution.
cliffhanger.open_question: How will Alexander punish the traitors now that his survival and their treason are exposed?

context_independence.name: context_independence
context_independence.reason: The core conflict—a betrayed military leader returning with proof to expose his corrupt family members—is universally understandable.
context_independence.blind_summary: Duke Alexander Ashburn presents top-secret War Office documents in a ruined cathedral, proving that Lord Henry Sterling and Rupert Ashburn betrayed his unit to the enemy three years ago. As the crimes and names are read aloud, Alexander confronts Rupert and reveals that they also stole his title.

confusions.issue: Exact relationship between Alexander, Rupert, and Lord Henry Sterling is not explicitly detailed beyond the shared family name Ashburn and accusations of betrayal.

curiosity_gap.name: curiosity_gap
curiosity_gap.reason: It delivers a satisfying mid-level payoff of the secret being exposed while withholding the ultimate revenge and punishment.
revealed: Alexander's unit was betrayed on the Iberian front.
Lord Henry Sterling and Rupert Ashburn were behind the leak.
They stole Alexander's title believing he was dead.
withheld: The exact consequences the traitors will face.
How Alexander survived and obtained the documents.

emotional_impact.name: emotional_impact
emotional_impact.reason: The combination of severe military betrayal, public exposure, and the sheer terror of the guilty parties creates strong audience satisfaction and tension.

stakes.value: A presumed-dead Duke returns with royal proof of treason and title theft against his own family members.

promo_dna.appeal: A betrayed war hero returns from the dead with royal proof to destroy the family that stole his life.
